$comment: Short motion pieces built the way the brand moves. Entrances use the motion tokens (--ds-easing-out over --ds-duration-slow, never ease-in), staggered a little; the toon objects then drift the way the site's sticker field does (a few pixels and a degree or two on a 9 to 15 second loop, --ds-easing-in-out); the band's grain jumps between eight offsets every 80ms as the band divider's does. Nothing exits: a clip ends on the finished frame, so it loops cleanly into a still.
